sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No canonical candidate is verified because none represents very-long-hatch applicability or controlled classification-society permission.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the reduced-load alternative: it may be used only for the verified very-long-hatch case and must represent classification-society permission; the current shape accepts a 100 <= value < 150 kN/m on any applicable strip. Determine the very-long-hatch condition from the supplied hatchOpeningLength and shipBreadth inputs and scope permittedReducedLineLoad to that condition. Replace the existence-only quantity checks, which allow malformed additional values to pass, with conditional SHACL Core property/node constraints that validate every actual/required quantity value, its decimal numericValue, and unit. Keep one bounded SPARQL comparison for actualSectionModulus >= requiredSectionModulus and actualShearArea >= requiredShearArea, and express the [100,150) kN/m bounds with SHACL Core.

Remove the invented test that a hatch is 'very long' when hatchOpeningLength exceeds shipBreadth; clause 4.5.3 supplies no such criterion, and those terms are linked to TRF-056 rather than this requirement. Use the matcher to locate a canonical very-long-hatch applicability term or controlled permission term. Retain the reduced p*h interval as >=100 and <150 kN/m and require classification-society approval only for that derogation. Replace the OPTIONAL-heavy SPARQL with one bounded query using direct bindings to check actualSectionModulus >= requiredSectionModulus and actualShearArea >= requiredShearArea for applicable strips, leaving presence, datatype, unit, and conditional structure to SHACL Core.
